name: Norwegian University of Life Sciences (NMBU)
summary: Life-sciences university in Ås, near Oslo; one English bachelor’s, in environment and development studies, with a field course in India or Tanzania.

handoff.label: Application procedures, programmes taught in English

ib.text: Still at school? Apply through Samordna opptak, which needs Norwegian at B2: Danish, Norwegian or Swedish A, or Norwegian B HL, at grade 3 covers it. English A at 3 or English B at 5.

apply.via: Samordna opptak, or Søknadsweb for diploma holders

dates.label: Direct route closes: diploma already in hand, no Norwegian (page gives no year)
Samordna opptak deadline (with Danish, Norwegian or Swedish A) (page gives no year)

programmes.name: International Environment and Development Studies
programmes.ib: Through Samordna opptak, Norwegian at B2 is required even though teaching is in English: Danish, Norwegian or Swedish A, or Norwegian B HL, at grade 3 documents it.

notes: The 1 December direct route gives no conditional offers: you must already hold your diploma, so a May 2027 IB candidate cannot use it.
The direct route is for applicants whose school is outside the Nordic countries; NMBU does not say where an IB taken in Denmark falls.
NMBU does not offer scholarships for bachelor students.
